title: Send a wire or ACH payment
summary: Move money out of the company bank account — create a wire or ACH payment behind an approval gate.

parts.title: Collect payee details and amount
parts.guidance: Identify the obligation, payee, amount, currency and intended payment date from the invoice or other supporting record. Verify beneficiary instructions through a known contact, especially after bank-detail changes, and check for an existing payment. Resolve discrepancies before creating the transfer and keep bank details in the payment system.

execution.rationale: Source-record analysis is local, but independent beneficiary verification requires an established payee contact channel.

parts.title: Create the wire/ACH payment in the bank
parts.guidance: Compare the available methods for the beneficiary and currency using the provider’s fees, delivery estimates and information requirements. Draft the selected transfer with its funding account, amount, reference and verified recipient details. Check the preview against the obligation so the later bank approver can assess the complete transaction, including conversion and additional charges.

options.title: Default — Create the wire/ACH payment in the bank
options.summary: Enter the verified beneficiary and account details for the chosen wire or ACH route. Select the funding account and check the bank’s displayed fee, delivery estimate and total against the obligation. Use a reference the payee can reconcile, then leave the completed bank instruction in its draft or pending-approval state for the authorized release step.

execution.rationale: Mercury's request-send-money operation queues the verified payment for dashboard approval without releasing it automatically.

options.title: Cross-border payout
options.summary: Establish the currency and account format the overseas payee can receive. Compare the full quote, exchange rate, intermediary charges and delivery estimate across eligible routes. Select the quote that fits the obligation, noting its expiry and the amount expected at the recipient. Include those details in the payment awaiting bank approval and reconcile any eventual shortfall or return.
options.when: The payee is outside the US - multi-currency rails beat a USD wire

execution.rationale: Wise is listed, but the currency-specific quote, transfer approval and settlement-trace operations are not evidenced here.

parts.title: Approver releases the payment in the banking dashboard
parts.guidance: The designated bank approver checks beneficiary, amount, currency, funding account, fees and business purpose in the bank’s trusted interface. Resolve changed instructions and duplicate warnings against the source obligation before authorizing release. Follow the bank’s actual result: processing, rejection or additional review requires follow-up before the payment can be treated as settled.

execution.rationale: The designated bank approver personally authorizes the payment in the bank's trusted dashboard.

parts.title: Confirm the payment settled and reconcile it
parts.guidance: Match the bank’s completed payment to the obligation using the debit and transaction reference. If receipt is uncertain, use a trace or provider confirmation and the verified payee contact to investigate. Reconcile fees, exchange differences and returns separately from principal, then update the payable to reflect what actually settled. Keep shortfalls and unresolved transfers open.

execution.rationale: Mercury supplies payment and trace records; the payable ledger and verified-payee contact channel needed for receipt investigation and reconciliation are not selected.

metadata.supportReason: The banking APIs expose payments (wires/ACH) — an agent prepares and creates the payment; a human approver releases it before money moves.
